_comment: The persist-list, moved out of prose and into data. scripts/tick.py stages exactly these paths, rebuilds the nested tree from flat staging, and computes the write/delete plan itself. Two entries may not share a basename, because staging is flat. Anything under 'required' aborts the tick if absent rather than running partially.
_queue_note: Queue items are discovered dynamically: whatever is present under reports/tasks/handoffs pending must be added to 'files' by the caller for that tick. tick.py captures their moves automatically once staged, so no queue path is ever hand-listed in a prompt.
